# GitHub Copilot model cards

<!-- Generated by models/generate.py from models/catalog.json. Edit the catalog, then run `python3 generate.py --write`. -->

A catalog of the models offered in the **GitHub Copilot CLI** and the **GitHub Copilot app**, checked 2026-10-06, with each model's system card or model card from its publisher.

- [**Model catalog and coverage**](models/README.md): 42 folders (28 current, 1 limited, 1 utility-only, 12 retired) and 35 publisher documents (34 PDFs, 1 Markdown card).
- Each folder has an original **digest** of capabilities, evaluations, safety findings, limitations, and practical implications, with page citations, plus **provenance** (owner URL, retrieval date, size, SHA-256) and **variants**.
- [**Rights review**](models/RIGHTS.md): 2 documents are licensed for redistribution and committed in full. The other 33 are linked, not redistributed; a verified local workflow downloads them and produces complete page-marked Markdown extractions.
- [**Scope and gaps**](models/README.md#document-scope-and-gaps): GPT-5.4 nano and Raptor mini have no publisher card; some models are covered by a family or shared card, and each mapping's evidence is recorded in its `source.md`.

Roster evidence comes from GitHub's [supported-models documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/ai-models/supported-models) and the Copilot app's model picker. Documents come only from their publishers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft, Moonshot AI, and xAI.

## Quick start

```sh
cd models
python3 -m pip install -r requirements-local.txt  # PyMuPDF, used for extraction and checks
python3 local_cards.py --all                      # download, verify, and extract every PDF locally
python3 generate.py --check                       # validate the catalog, digests, and generated files
python3 roster_check.py                           # compare the catalog with GitHub's live tables
```

See [models/README.md](models/README.md#maintenance) for maintenance steps.
